name: Blueprints
author: Glutoblop
description: Mark built pieces with the hammer, save them as a named blueprint, then place the whole thing at once from a Blueprints tab in the hammer menu (full material cost).

changelog.0.1.0: Initial release: Blueprints tab in the hammer menu, selection tool (click / Shift+click connected), save, rename, delete, and placing a blueprint for its full material cost.
